title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：size　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 size 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the tailor ① took the size that no customer in the shop would have counted, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② size, meaning the measure itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a size, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ size in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ size at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A size, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the tailor said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the size was the whole of the matter, meaning the proportion and not the measure. The ⑥ size, meaning the proportion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; size, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a measure and a proportion. He said the proportion is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ size had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ size of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of counting; size, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ size I remember is the measure counted in the order, which closed in 1976 and is still counted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ size, my mother said in 1978, is the only measure that improves by being counted; every size, she said, is a proportion that has agreed to look like a measure. She said the proportion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尺寸；大小（指裁缝铺里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 尺寸；大小（指那个尺寸本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the size 量这一个尺寸
D. n. 尺寸；大小（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 尺寸之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的尺寸之事）
F. n. 尺寸；大小（指订单簿里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 尺寸、分寸（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分寸（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the size that no customer in the shop would have counted
The size, meaning the measure itself and not the needle
the size at the far mirror
the size was the whole of the matter
the size had become a line in an order
The size of the whole thing
A size, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: take the size 意为“量这一个尺寸”，1969 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯清点的一个尺寸做了一遍。
size 意为“尺寸；大小”，指那个尺寸本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
size 意为“尺寸；大小”，指裁缝铺里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
size 意为“尺寸；大小”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
size 意为“尺寸、分寸”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个分寸就是那件事的全部。
size 意为“分寸”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个尺寸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
size 意为“尺寸；大小”，指订单簿里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1974 年这一个成了订单簿里的一行。
size 意为“尺寸之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的尺寸之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的清点。
size 意为“尺寸；大小”，我记得的是订单簿里清点过的那一个，1976 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一个。
size 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，尺寸是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的尺寸。
